slots.purpose: The resolution marks out a shared space, and topicality asks whether the plan sits inside it.
slots.subject: A wide, flat field enclosed by a simple low fence of round-topped posts and two plain rails. Inside the field sit five small plain blocks, like building blocks, spread out with space between them. One more block of the same size sits just outside the fence on the right, on the bare ground.
slots.composition: Seen from slightly above, so the whole fence reads as a rounded rectangle. The field fills the middle two thirds of the frame. The five inside blocks are spread evenly across the field. The outside block sits close to the right fence, a little below centre, clearly on the far side of it. A thin ground line runs along the bottom. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: Fence posts and rails are white with black outlines. The field inside the fence is light grey #e1e4e8. The ground outside is plain white. All six blocks are white with black outlines and look the same. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No gate, signs, animals, trees, people or arrows. Do not make the outside block look broken, sad or different in any way except where it sits.
slots.alt: A fenced field with several blocks inside and one block just outside the fence, like a plan that falls outside the resolution's limits.
slots.caption: Topicality asks whether the plan sits inside the topic.

slots.purpose: Show the four parts of a T argument in order, with the aff's direct answer to the first two.
slots.diagram_spec: Top row: four rounded boxes left to right, joined by plain arrows pointing right. Box 1: title 'Interpretation', line under it 'What a word in the resolution means'. Box 2: title 'Violation', line 'How the plan falls outside that meaning'. Box 3: title 'Standards', line 'Why that meaning is better for debate'. Box 4: title 'Voters', line 'Why T should decide the round'. A small label above the row, at the left: 'Negative' in neg red text #c8161f; the four boxes have a thin neg red #f2232d top strip, because T is the neg's argument. Ink outlines and text, white fills. Bottom row: two small chips joined by a thin vertical line to the boxes above them, with a small label at the left 'Affirmative answers' in aff blue #0055b8. Under Interpretation: chip 'Counter-interpretation: our meaning, which the plan meets'. Under Violation: chip 'We meet: the plan fits your meaning'. Both chips have an aff blue #0055b8 outline. Under Standards: chip 'Our standards, and answers to yours' (blue outline). Under Voters: chip 'Reasonability: the plan is topical enough' (blue outline). On narrow screens the four columns stack top to bottom, each box with its answer chip under it.
slots.alt: Diagram of the four parts of topicality in order: interpretation, violation, standards, voters, with the aff's answer to each part shown underneath.
slots.caption: The four parts of a T argument, and how the aff answers each one.

slots.purpose: The interpretation sets a clear line, and the violation shows the plan does not fit through it.
slots.subject: A simple open size gauge, like the metal frame used to check if a bag fits: a plain rectangular frame standing upright on a flat base. Beside it stands a plain box that is clearly taller and wider than the opening of the frame.
slots.composition: Side view. The gauge stands left of centre on a thin ground line. The box stands right of centre on the same ground line, a short gap away from the gauge, so the eye can compare its size with the opening. The top edge of the box rises well above the top bar of the gauge. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: The gauge frame is ink with a white inside. The box is white with a black outline and a light grey #cfd4da front face. The ground line is light grey #e1e4e8. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No suitcase handles, wheels, airport scenes, rulers with marks, numbers or tick marks. No people or hands.
slots.alt: A box stands beside an open size gauge and is clearly too big to fit through it. An interpretation sets a clear line; the violation shows the plan is outside it.
slots.caption: The interpretation sets the line; the violation shows the plan does not fit.

slots.purpose: Standards are the bridge that carries an interpretation to a reason to vote.
slots.subject: A simple flat footbridge made of five equal planks laid side by side, spanning a gap between two flat-topped platforms. On the left platform lies a plain card with three straight lines on it (the interpretation). On the right platform lies a plain ballot card with two straight lines and an empty square box on it.
slots.composition: Side view, centred. The two platforms are plain blocks rising from the bottom edge, one at the left and one at the right, at the same height. The bridge spans straight across between them, with the five planks clearly separate and equal. The gap under the bridge is empty white space. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: Platforms are light grey #cfd4da with black outlines. The five planks are white with black outlines. Both cards are white with black outlines and ink lines. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No water, rope, railings with patterns, trees, people or arrows. No ticks or crosses in the ballot box.
slots.alt: A bridge of five planks joins a definition card to a ballot card, showing how standards carry an interpretation to a reason to vote.
slots.caption: Standards are the bridge from a meaning of the word to a reason to vote.

slots.purpose: Show competing interpretations: two meanings of a word draw the topic's edge in different places, and the judge picks the better one.
slots.subject: Two plain measuring tapes laid flat side by side along the ground, both starting at the same fence post on the left of a low fence. The upper tape is shorter and ends at a nearer fence post; the lower tape is longer and ends at a farther fence post. The tapes have no markings.
slots.composition: The fence runs left to right along the back of the picture with round-topped posts and plain rails. The two tapes lie in front of it, starting together on the left and ending at different posts. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: The shorter upper tape is neg red #f2232d (the neg's narrower interpretation). The longer lower tape is aff blue #0055b8 (the aff's counter-interpretation). The fence is ink and white.
slots.avoid: No numbers, ticks or markings on the tapes. No balance scale, gavel or legal symbols. No people or hands.
slots.alt: Two unmarked measuring tapes start at the same fence post: a short red one (the neg interpretation) and a longer blue one (the aff counter-interpretation).
slots.caption: Under competing interpretations, the judge picks the better of the two lines.

slots.purpose: An effects violation says the plan acts outside the topic and reaches it only through a chain of later results.
slots.subject: A plain block sits on bare ground outside a low fence of round-topped posts and plain rails. From the block, a chain of four linked rings runs across the ground, passes under the fence, and its last ring rests inside the fenced field.
slots.composition: Seen from slightly above. The fence runs from top to bottom a little right of centre, with the field to its right. The block sits at the left. The chain runs left to right from the block to just inside the fence. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: Fence, block and rings are white with black outlines. The field inside the fence is light grey #e1e4e8. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No arrows, people, animals, signs or gate. Do not break the chain.
slots.alt: A block outside a fence reaches into the fenced field only through a long chain of rings, like a plan that is topical only through its effects.
slots.caption: Effects T: the plan reaches the topic only through a chain of results.

slots.purpose: An extra topicality violation says the plan has a topical part plus an extra part outside the topic.
slots.subject: Two plain blocks joined side by side by a short coupling bar, like two train cars. The first block sits inside a fenced field. The second block hangs over the fence and rests on the bare ground outside it.
slots.composition: Seen from slightly above. The fence runs from top to bottom a little right of centre, with the field to its left. The first block sits inside the field, left of the fence. The coupling bar crosses the fence line, and the second block sits just right of the fence. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: Fence and both blocks are white with black outlines. The field inside the fence is light grey #e1e4e8. The coupling bar is ink. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No wheels, rails, arrows, people, signs or gate. Do not show the blocks cut apart.
slots.alt: Two joined blocks: one sits inside a fenced field, the other sticks out past the fence, like a plan with a topical part and an extra part.
slots.caption: Extra T: one part of the plan is topical, and another part goes outside the topic.
